_doc: Head office in Meridian Tower (the CBD's tallest). Tiers are bought outright (counted in net worth at their price) and cost upkeep each day. wholesale = discount on every case; footfall = boost to every shop. Campaigns need a head office (tier) and boost every shop's footfall for `days` (and reputation once).
